title: Alchemist's Painted Study
description: A wooden alchemist's desk sits against a wall covered in sweeping blue and green brushstrokes. An open book, glowing potion bottles, a lantern, and scattered papers occupy the desk while a large tilted mirror reflects the colorful painted interior.
prompt: Interior of a whimsical alchemist workshop with a large wooden desk covered in open books, glowing blue and green potion bottles, a brass lantern, and scattered parchment. A large golden mirror on the wall is tilted, reflecting the room. The back wall is covered in expressive sweeping brushstrokes of bright blue and lime green paint, creating an artistic and magical atmosphere.
